verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Increase publishes an official CLI in its own GitHub organization (Increase/increase-cli), so the product itself provides the capability. However, this single probe line is the only evidence: nothing describes the CLI's commands, auth, coverage of the API, or any AI or agent-oriented use. Missing for 10: documentation of CLI commands and API coverage, authentication/sandbox usage details, evidence of agent-friendly features like structured output, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
